About I’m an associate professor of Computer Science at Université Grenoble Alpes, teaching at IM2AG (UGA) and Ensimag (Grenoble INP).
I conduct my research within the GAIA team at GIPSA-lab. My research interests include Bayesian inference, statistical signal processing, probabilistic learning, multifractal analysis, and applications in medical imaging.
Before joining Université Grenoble Alpes, I was a postdoctoral research associate at CREATIS and Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1 from 2023 to 2025, working with Adrian Basarab. Since January 2025, I have been a member of the EURASIP Academy.

Selected professional milestones.
2027 [Upcoming - 09/2027] Event Organization.
Student Activities Co-chair for EUSIPCO 2027 in Darmstadt, Germany. 2026 [Upcoming - 11/2026] Event Organization.
Co-organizing the 2nd Spring School in Deep Learning in Buenos Aires, Argentina. [08/2026] Conference Paper.
Our paper “Bayesian estimation for the bivariate multifractal spectrum from incomplete data” will be presented at EUSIPCO 2026 in Bruges, Belgium. [07/2026] Project Funding.
Awarded funding from the MIAI Cluster for the DLxLatAm project, supporting mobility and accommodation grants for Latin American students attending the Spring School in Deep Learning. [05/2026] Special Session Organization.
Co-organized the special session “Scale-free Models and Analysis” with Herwig Wendt at ICASSP 2026 in Barcelona, Spain. 2025 [10/2025] Event Organization.
Co-organized the 1st Spring School in Deep Learning in Buenos Aires, Argentina. [2025–2027] Research Grant.
The project Advanced Robust Estimation and Performance Bounds was selected for the Université Grenoble Alpes research support program for new faculty members. [09/2025] New Position.
Joined Université Grenoble Alpes and GIPSA-lab as Associate Professor of Computer Science. [07/2025] Journal Paper.
Our paper “A Weighted Hankel Approach and Cramér–Rao Bound Analysis for Quantitative Acoustic Microscopy Imaging” was published in Computers in Biology and Medicine. [04/2025] Plenary Talk.
Invited plenary speaker at the Randomness and Fractals meeting in Vannes, France, with the talk “Multivariate Multifractal Parameter Estimation Using Bayesian Inference”. [01/2025] EURASIP Academy.
Selected as a member of the EURASIP Academy. 2024 [10/2024] Academic Visit.
Research visit at Weill Cornell Medicine in New York, working with the biomedical imaging team on quantitative acoustic microscopy. [08/2024] Conference Service.
Chaired the Biomedical Image Processing session and coordinated the student volunteer team at EUSIPCO 2024 in Lyon, France. 2023 [05/2023] Journal Paper.
Our paper “Bounds for the Estimation of Matrix-Valued Parameters of a Gaussian Random Process” was published in Signal Processing. [03/2023] New Position.
Joined CREATIS and Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1 as a postdoctoral research associate, working on data science for quantitative acoustic microscopy. 2022 [12/2022] PhD.
Completed my PhD in Signal Processing at the National Polytechnic Institute of Toulouse, with a thesis on Bayesian estimation for multivariate multifractal analysis. [06/2022] Journal Paper.
Our paper “A Bayesian framework for multivariate multifractal analysis” was published in IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing. 2019 [01/2019] Fellowship.
Awarded a CARMIN–IHP–CIMPA Fellowship to participate in the Mathematics of Imaging thematic program at the Institut Henri Poincaré in Paris.
